pattern: union two differently-headered tables after renaming, pivot with conditional aggregation
question: compare average daily attendance rate per centre across the two years, one row each
gold_sql: WITH combined AS (SELECT "Centre" AS centre, 2023 AS year, "Avg Daily Present" / "Enrolled Kids" * 100.0 AS rate FROM attendance_2023 UNION ALL SELECT centre_name AS centre, 2024 AS year, average_attendance / enrolment * 100.0 AS rate FROM attendance_2024) SELECT centre, AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN rate END) AS avg_rate_2023, AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN rate END) AS avg_rate_2024 FROM combined GROUP BY centre ORDER BY centre
sql_duckdb: WITH avg_2023 AS (SELECT Centre, AVG("Avg Daily Present") AS avg_daily_present_2023 FROM "attendance_2023" GROUP BY Centre), avg_2024 AS (SELECT centre_name AS Centre, AVG("average_attendance") AS avg_daily_present_2024 FROM "attendance_2024" GROUP BY centre_name) SELECT COALESCE(a2023.Centre, a2024.Centre) AS Centre, a2023.avg_daily_present_2023, a2024.avg_daily_present_2024 FROM avg_2023 AS a2023 FULL OUTER JOIN avg_2024 AS a2024 ON a2023.Centre = a2024.Centre

WITH avg_2023 AS (
  SELECT
    Centre,
    AVG("Avg Daily Present") AS avg_daily_present_2023
  FROM "attendance_2023"
  GROUP BY Centre
),
avg_2024 AS (
  SELECT
    centre_name AS Centre,
    AVG("average_attendance") AS avg_daily_present_2024
  FROM "attendance_2024"
  GROUP BY centre_name
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(a2023.Centre, a2024.Centre) AS Centre,
  a2023.avg_daily_present_2023,
  a2024.avg_daily_present_2024
FROM avg_2023 a2023
FULL OUTER JOIN avg_2024 a2024
  ON a2023.Centre = a2024.Centre;
